note: Small Worth County Conservation campground on the north shore of 330-acre Silver Lake near Northwood, with a shelter overlooking the lake. The county calls it ideal for smaller campers; arrive with full tanks. The entrance off 500th St is easy to miss, 200 yards west of the fishing jetty. --Claude
summary: Rate: the park page now says $15 (self-registration), while the older facility and activity pages say $10; $15 written. 8 sites, 20-amp (the facility page says 30; snapped down), no water, pit toilet, April 15 to Nov 1, self-registration with no online booking. Lakeview kept: the small gravel loop sits ~25-60 m from a 330-acre lake behind a thin tree belt, with open lawn toward the shore on its east side. The county says 'All sites are located next to the lake'. Pin OK.
flags: RATE CONFLICT on the operator's own pages: the park overview says '$15 per night' and the facility/activity pages say '$10 per night'; neither is dated. $15 is written because the overview is the more detailed text, and a camper report on Campendium gives $15 in April 2025. AMPERAGE CONFLICT: the park page says 20 amp, the facility page 30 amp; 20 written (snap down).

WATERFRONT: lakeview kept; no lakefront. NAIP: the campground is a small gravel crescent loop at the pin. Its south end is ~25 m from the shoreline of Silver Lake (330 acres per the county) through a belt of trees, and the far sites are ~50-60 m from it. East of the loop an open mown lawn with scattered trees runs ~60-80 m to the shore, with the lake shelter on it. The county says 'All sites are located next to the lake' and the shelter 'overlooks the lake'. Trees and lawn (day use around the shelter) sit between the pads and the water, so there is no open-apron lakefront. There are no official campsite photos, so the view is inferred from imagery and the county's wording: weak spot.

FIT: the county says 'This campground is ideal for smaller campers'; no pad lengths are posted. A 23-ft motorhome is plausible on the loop, but unconfirmed. Keep with the caveat (the note carries it).

NEIGHBOUR: a row of ~15-20 trailers/campers along a lane immediately west of the county loop (reached from the west side) looks like a separate seasonal or private lot, not part of the county's 8 sites. Observation only.
PHONE 641-324-1524 confirmed (facility page 'Ph: 641-324-1524'; park page office number). Address 497 500th St, Northwood.
PIN: stored 43.48494,-93.42015 is on the campground loop. OK.
